inspection.method: Read immutable Git objects, not the running writer uncommitted implementation; this is recovery/reference analysis, not substitute Fresh Review.
facts: Declared UI/build stack is TypeScript5.9.3 and Vite7.3.1; no React/Vue/UI component framework dependency in production/package.json.
Existing custom UI foundation includes PresentationSession/PanelRenderer, WidgetRegistry/WidgetSlot, MountScope event/own/accept lifetime and command guards.
Production boundary checker enforces declared ownership via frozen checker byte copies in disposable directories; passing this alone does not prove maintainable UI structure.

sources.title: Thinking in React
sources.usedPrinciple: Separate cohesive components, pass customization as inputs, keep minimal nonduplicated state and identify its owner. Applying these principles here is Coordinator engineering judgment, not a request to adopt React.

sources.title: MDN EventTarget.addEventListener
sources.usedPrinciple: Listeners can be explicitly removed or scoped with AbortSignal; abort removes associated listeners. Existing MountScope cleanup remains the local ownership boundary, not automatically replaced.

sources.title: WAI-ARIA APG Menu Button
sources.usedPrinciple: Button opens command menu with deliberate keyboard focus and expanded state. Reusable implementation must preserve menu semantics.

sources.title: WAI-ARIA APG Modal Dialog
sources.usedPrinciple: Modal focus containment, Escape and logical focus return are explicit behaviors; do not make every floating surface modal merely to share code.

engineeringConclusion: Reuse existing owned presentation/mount/widget seams and introduce only the small shared UI entry required by actual callers. A framework cannot substitute for boundaries, shared mechanism, clear state ownership or source-level review. No dependency installation or framework migration requested/authorized by this note.
reviewChecks: One clear owner for shared positioning/open/close/cleanup and bounded primitive styles; current callers supply content/size/anchor/alignment. No caller-name special cases or hidden reach into feature state.
At least multiple real current consumers exercise the shared entry. Preserve necessary semantic variants; avoid giant catch-all helper, unused option matrix or location-only duplication.
Single authoritative model state through existing projections; no mirrored Graph copies or private reflection. Diagnostic snapshots remain correctly bounded/lifetime-invalidated.
Listeners/subscriptions/observers/async callbacks cleaned on close, unmount and dispose as appropriate; multiple instances independent, stale work fenced.

Source-level review inspects ownership and reuse alongside continuous pointer, focus/keyboard, geometry, narrow/wide and noGraph/History mutation behavior. Test pass and screenshots alone cannot close structure requirement.
authority: References support implementation choices within already accepted Human constraints and repository contracts; external docs grant no product/architecture/Slice authority. Coordinator does not implement or issue independent technical PASS.
next: Original writer includes its concrete common-interface/consumer/lifecycle mapping in delivery; fresh isolated reviewer evaluates it independently.
